svg.title: Guardian reconstruction — generated layout and movement routes
svg.desc: Top-down footprint of the Roblox Lua approximation. North is Green, south is Blue, west is Sniper, and east is Gold. Floor colors indicate height. Three lift routes and two eighteen-stud jump routes are shown. This schematic does not verify a one-to-one Halo reconstruction.
svg.metadata: Source: Guardian.lua; SHA-256: a3640da4aa1dbc0828aa1498102877c5b91439cf51ad1734b685a53a3dec43b5; Export: scene.json; Offline Lua mock and oriented geometry checks; not Roblox engine validation
